directory.title: Sent to manager directory
directory.sub: Managers see your photo and live pin on the map. They hire technicians for a task — hired techs join one group automatically.
steps: You create a profile with photo + live location.
Manager opens a task and sees technicians on the map.
Manager selects technicians → group chat is created automatically.
You do the site visit (photos + notes) → AI builds report + devis.
After approval & client signature, you get the intervention assignment.
